Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class FileTransferManager

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.FileTransferManager
public final class FileTransferManager extends Object
The streaming driver for peer-to-peer file transfer over one SecureChannel. It owns the offer/accept/reject/progress/cancel control plane (as P2pMessages) and the DATA-plane chunking, and advances a FileTransfer model for each exchange so the UI can observe progress without touching I/O.

Sending. offerFile(Path) hashes the file (SHA-256), announces it with a FILE_OFFER, and - once the peer accepts - streams it in 65536-byte chunks on a dedicated daemon thread (so the channel's reader thread stays free to receive, including a mid-send cancel). A FILE_END carrying the hash closes the stream.

Receiving. A FILE_OFFER is surfaced to the FileTransferManager.Listener for the user to accept or reject; nothing is written until accept(String). An accepted file is written to a temporary sibling with an incremental SHA-256, and only on a FILE_END whose hash matches is it atomically renamed into place - so a truncated or tampered transfer never lands as a finished file. The received name is hardened against path traversal ("Zip-Slip") exactly like the Backup app: it is reduced to a base name, resolved under the download directory and normalised, and rejected if it escapes.

Listener callbacks fire on the reader thread (for inbound events) or the send worker (for outbound progress); as with the rest of the transport, the caller marshals to the EDT before touching any widget. Instances are thread-safe.

      public FileTransferManager(SecureChannel channel, String localNickname, Path downloadDir, FileTransferManager.Listener listener)
      Binds a manager to a channel.
      Parameters:
      channel - the secure channel to send/receive over (never null)
      localNickname - our display name, stamped into control messages
      downloadDir - where accepted files are written (never null)
      listener - the lifecycle sink (may be null)

  • Method Details

    • offerFile

      public FileTransfer offerFile(Path file) throws IOException
      Offers a local file to the peer. Computes its size and SHA-256, sends a FILE_OFFER, and returns the pending transfer; streaming begins automatically when the peer accepts.
      Parameters:
      file - the file to send
      Returns:
      the new transfer, never null
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file is missing/unreadable or cannot be hashed

    • accept

      public void accept(String transferId)
      Accepts an offered file: prepares a temporary destination under the download directory and sends FILE_ACCEPT. Bytes are written as they arrive and atomically renamed into place on a verified FILE_END.
      Parameters:
      transferId - the offered transfer's id

    • reject

      public void reject(String transferId, String reason)
      Rejects an offered file and tells the peer why.
      Parameters:
      transferId - the offered transfer's id
      reason - a human-readable reason (may be null)

    • cancel

      public void cancel(String transferId, String reason)
      Cancels an in-flight transfer on either side, cleaning up any partial file.
      Parameters:
      transferId - the transfer's id
      reason - a human-readable reason (may be null)

    • close

      public void close()
      Tears down every in-flight transfer (used when the channel closes).

    • handleControl

      public void handleControl(P2pMessage msg)
      Routes an inbound CONTROL message to the file-transfer state machine. Non-file kinds are ignored, so a caller can forward every control message here.
      Parameters:
      msg - the message (null is ignored)
